categories.main_business_segments: Shenzhen Sunwin Intelligent Co., Ltd. primarily operates in artificial intelligence (AI) hardware and software products, including industrial machine vision, robotics, unmanned aerial vehicles (drones), and intelligent video analysis platforms. The company also provides comprehensive solutions for smart cities, including smart transportation and urban infrastructure management, and operates in the internet gaming sector through its subsidiary Beijing Kaixinren Information Technology Co., Ltd. Additionally, it engages in medical technology and smart city operations through its subsidiaries.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company focuses on AI core technologies such as machine vision, autonomous navigation, intelligent control, multi-modal sensor fusion, deep learning algorithms, and big data analytics. It employs a production model combining in-house manufacturing of core components and outsourced processing for labor-intensive, low-value tasks. The company develops modular hardware and proprietary software, including AI-driven inspection robots, tethered and hybrid drones, and intelligent video security systems, with strong R&D collaboration with universities and research institutes.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include industrial sectors requiring automated inspection and maintenance (e.g., power, mining, metallurgy), urban infrastructure operators (e.g., city rail transit authorities), airports for low-altitude safety systems, and government/public safety agencies. The internet gaming business serves mobile and online game users primarily in China. The company also targets smart city projects and medical technology markets domestically and internationally.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China, with significant business in regions such as South China (including Shenzhen), North China, Central China, East China, Southwest China, and some overseas markets. It has subsidiaries and projects in cities like Beijing, Shanghai, Hangzhou, and international locations including Hong Kong and Kyrgyzstan. The company’s smart city and AI solutions are deployed across multiple Chinese provinces and cities.
categories.supply_chain_position: Sunwin Intelligent operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the supply chain, focusing on R&D, manufacturing, system integration, and direct sales of AI hardware and software products. It provides end-to-end solutions including product design, production, installation, and after-sales services, positioning itself as a comprehensive solution provider rather than a raw material supplier or component manufacturer.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic focus is on deepening AI core technology development, including machine vision, multi-modal fusion, intelligent control, and big data processing. It emphasizes upgrading and expanding its AI-enabled robotics and drone product lines, enhancing smart city and rail transit solutions, and expanding low-altitude safety and airport wildlife management platforms. R&D initiatives include industrial inspection robots, AI bird detection and deterrence systems, satellite intelligent algorithms, and integrated video management platforms, with ongoing collaboration with academic institutions.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through direct sales of AI hardware products (robots, drones), software platforms, and integrated smart city solutions. The company also earns income from internet game operations via self-operated, joint-operated, authorized, and agency models, primarily through in-game virtual item sales. Additionally, it receives government subsidies and project-based contract revenues, with some income from leasing investment properties.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: While specific competitors are not named, the company positions itself as a leading AI solution provider in industrial inspection robotics, smart city infrastructure, and low-altitude safety systems, breaking foreign monopolies in certain sectors like airport wildlife management. It holds multiple national certifications and standards leadership, with a strong R&D foundation and diversified product portfolio, aiming to maintain technological advantages amid increasing competition in AI and robotics industries.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 143.28 million, a 68% decline from the previous year, and a net loss attributable to shareholders of about RMB 507.32 million, indicating significant financial challenges and ongoing losses. Total assets were RMB 1.17 billion with equity of RMB 122.44 million. The company has experienced continuous losses since 2019 and faces liquidity and solvency risks, but is actively pursuing restructuring and operational optimization to stabilize growth.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Sunwin Intelligent emphasizes its comprehensive AI core technology stack, including proprietary algorithms and modular hardware design, enabling highly autonomous, intelligent inspection and monitoring solutions adaptable to complex industrial and urban environments. Its products offer enhanced safety, efficiency, and cost reduction through automation and AI-driven analytics. The company also highlights its ability to break foreign technology monopolies in specialized fields, such as airport low-altitude safety, and its integrated smart city platforms that unify data and operational management for clients.
